objective.primaryRule: No primary and no roles: nothing is searched for selection, ranked for a decision or selected. The study verifies the staged-stop delivery (staged-stop@1, protocol v3: CPU reference, CUDA port, host codec, domain) against the authoritative CPU engine and, only if every gate passes (PROTOCOL.md section 2), renews the GPU acceptance with a full checklist section 2 cycle for Priority 4 (research/vg-l0-staged-stop).

risk.denominator: one fixed $100,000 principal budget (not peak account equity)

budget.notes: No search proposals for selection. backendEvaluations caps fresh CPU evaluations on real data (the CPU references of the parity campaign, the finalists and the risk-delivery parity; the CPU arms of the Assignment 3 and staged mini schedules; the reliability run's samples). GPU evaluations are counted in the records; synthetic fixtures are not counted.

evaluationBackend.justification: Engineering acceptance study (GPU Phase 8, the staged-stop delivery): CPU evaluations are parity references (records, staged counters and risk envelopes) and the non-official CPU arms of the mini schedules; GPU runs are non-official replays of sealed jobs, mini schedules, parity, sanitizer and reliability tests. Nothing is official optimization evidence (standard 3.0.0 section 9.8); the engineering output, if every gate passes, is a new acceptance record (section 9.9) for the final code.

chronologicalConsequence: not applicable: a diagnostic with no search for selection and no chronological verdict

deviations.description: no roles and no primary; nothing is selected
deviations.justification: brief: engineering assignment; no trading-rule, fitness, search or selection change

deviations.description: no search for selection, no chronological verdict; sealed jobs of Assignments 3 and 2 replayed with their own frozen code and seeds (Assignment 3 C19 broad1 also with the risk envelope requested), and the parity-only mini schedule, compared by identity only
deviations.justification: brief Phase F: sealed historical candidate reproduction, fixed-seed mini-optimizer parity as engineering verification only

deviations.description: the CPU engine stays the authoritative canonical reference; its closure changes ONLY by the declared staged-stop additions (src/staged-stop, src/d1-risk-controls-rc3, the Growth engine revision 1.5.0 option, the books.ts pass-through), with the stage OFF identical to the previous engine (the Growth 1.4.0 OFF-parity fixture, the sealed replays of Assignments 3/2 and Stage B, the finalists); every result of the final path must reproduce the canonical CPU engine or a sealed record
deviations.justification: Priority 4 (research/vg-l0-staged-stop/brief/BRIEF.md section 3) requires the S1 CPU reference with exact OFF parity before its CUDA port; standard 3.0.0 section 9.6 (the TypeScript engine authoritative).

deviations.description: not applicable: no fold primary or final candidate
no tuning benchmark: batch size and host workers stay Phase 4 decisions; timings are reported (the pilot compute estimate), never decision inputs
bounded reliability (two concurrent processes x 32 minutes) instead of an endurance test
deviations.justification: brief Phase F: bounded reliability testing
